ValidationRule.description: A restriction to stop Council Fine cases being closed without the relevant details being filled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.Name = "Council Fine" && (ISBLANK ( Fine_Date_of_Offence__c ) || ISBLANK( Fine_Date_Received__c ) || ISBLANK( FPN_PCN_Reference__c )) && ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This case cannot be Closed until the fields "Fine - Date of Offence", "Fine - Date_Received", "Fine - Reason for Fine" and "Fine - FPN Number" have been filled out.
